zip_python_files: zip python files from directories or paths into an output zip with stripped prefixes and prepend strings
create_zip_with_deny_list: create a zip archive of python source files while excluding standard library modules like dbm, curses, and tkinter
run_zip_script_strip_dir: run the zip script to bundle python files from a directory, stripping a specified root directory from all paths
build_zip_with_prepend: build a zip file of python sources with a custom string prepended to every file path inside the archive
test_write_to_zip: test the write_to_zip function to add individual python files to a zip archive with path stripping and deny-list filtering
